text:
alex.s: FYI rolling maintenance planned tomorrow 03/18 02:00-03:00 UTC — storage node TLS cert rotation. Expected impact: short reconnect spikes (~10s) for long-lived streaming sessions, otherwise no data-plane downtime. Will drain and rotate per-region in sequence.

maria.k: thanks. can we avoid eu-west1 during the 02:00-02:30 UTC peak? merchant batch jobs run then.

alex.s: good catch — we can shift eu-west1 to the tail of the window (02:40-03:00). updating customer comms.

jess_ops: add runbook note: if we see >1% 503s for 5m, abort and rollback cert on that pool. Also prepare rollback command:

```
# rollback to previous cert bundle
redwoodctl storage cert rollback --pool eu-west1 --to sha256:abc123
```

alex.s: added to runbook and ops checklist. statuspage draft below before I post to #announcements.

alex.s: incidents-bot: scheduling pager window 02:00-03:00 UTC for storage_tls_rotations.

incidents-bot: SCHEDULED PAGER CREATED for storage_tls_rotations | window: 3861283200-3861286800 UTC | oncall: eng-oncall rota. Link: https://pager.redwood.ai/rotations/2345

product_tom: can we include a customer-facing note that calls out transient reconnects but no data loss? want to reassure enterprise customers.

alex.s: yep — draft customer notice: 

"During a scheduled maintenance window (03/18 02:00-03:00 UTC) we will rotate TLS certificates on storage nodes. Applications using long-lived connections may briefly reconnect (10-30s). No data loss is expected. If you have scheduled jobs during this window, consider shifting them or contact support)."

jess_ops: LGTM. add contact blurb for customers to open support ticket with tag `maintenance-impact`.

-- 03/18 02:12 UTC (during window) --

incidents-bot: Pager TRIGGERED: storage_ingress_503_rate > threshold in us-west1 (5m avg 1.8%). Pager url: https://pager.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-20260318-01

samir.r: I'm on it. looking at ingress logs. opening temporary rate-limiter bypass for streaming connections to reduce reconnection cascades.

jess_ops: instructing drain pause on affected pool to stop further rotation while we triage.

samir.r: applied bypass flag: `--streaming-bypass=true` for us-west1. error rate down to 0.4% now. continuing verification.

oncall-bot: Handoff reminder: @jess_ops you are primary oncall for next 30m. escalate to @alex.s if we need rollback.

jess_ops: noted. preparing rollback plan in case we see repeat spike >1% for 10m.

samir.r: verifying client reconnection patterns — looks like some SDKs retry aggressively and overwhelm ingress during cert rotation. mitigation: touchpoint with client SDK team to add jittered backoff.

product_tom: drafting brief statuspage and customer email now.

alex.s: statuspage update (post this template if we keep mitigations stable):

"Short-term impact: Some customers experienced brief reconnects (03/18 02:10 UTC) during a scheduled TLS certificate rotation on storage nodes in us-west1. Engineers applied a temporary streaming bypass and paused rotation on the affected pool; error rates returned to baseline. No data loss detected. Rotation will resume after verification. We will follow up with a full post-mortem if any regressions are found"

jess_ops: customer email template (concise):

"Hello — During today’s scheduled maintenance (03/18 02:00-03:00 UTC) some customers on us-west1 experienced brief reconnects around 02:10 UTC as we rotated TLS certificates. Our engineers mitigated the issue by pausing rotation and applying a temporary bypass; services are operating normally. If you saw persistent errors, please reply with logs or open a ticket and tag `maintenance-impact`. We’re investigating root cause and will share a follow-up. — Redwood Inference Ops"

alex.s: posted statuspage and queued customer email to affected tenants. link: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/20260318-storage-rotations

incidents-bot: STATUSPAGE UPDATED by alex.s | incident: INC-20260318-01 | visibility: partial-impact | customers_notified: true

-- 03/18 02:55 UTC (window nearing end) --

samir.r: resumed rotation in us-west1 after 20m verification, no regressions.

jess_ops: verified metrics across regions, token issuance and streaming p99 latency normal.

alex.s: closing scheduled pager window and marking maintenance complete. will send final customer completion message and open a short RCA.

incidents-bot: SCHEDULED PAGER CLOSED | storage_tls_rotations | closed_by: alex.s | end_ts: 3861241367

alex.s: final customer completion note: 

"Maintenance complete (03/18 03:00 UTC). All rotated nodes are healthy. We observed a brief spike in reconnects during the us-west1 rotation which was mitigated within 20 minutes. No data loss. RCA in progress, ETA 48h for a short post-mortem and action items." :white_check_mark:

product_tom: thanks team. looks good to follow up with SDK team on better client backoff.

jess_ops: filing incident card in tracker and attaching logs + runbook updates.

alex.s: good job — thumbs up all around :thumbsup:
